implementation_notes: Added only the required exported ErrInvalidKey sentinel. Existing interfaces, structs, method signatures and backend protocol remain unchanged.
Lookup rejects strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" before Backend.Find, covering empty, ASCII-whitespace and Unicode-whitespace keys. Accepted keys are passed unchanged.
ErrMissing is still returned directly for direct, wrapped or joined BackendMissing causes; every failure discards any backend value.

Unavailable failures use fmt.Errorf("lookup account %q: %w", key, ErrUnavailable), preserving public classification while avoiding backend identity, error type and diagnostics. Quoted key context escapes control characters.

Consumer-package tests cover backend suppression, direct missing equality, success forwarding, unusable failure values, unavailable classification/context, backend identity/type privacy and valid noncomparable backend errors.
README now documents classifications and consumer usage without task-history prose.

The initial tests compiled and failed because blank keys reached the backend and unavailable errors lacked lookup/key context. After implementing the behavior, the blank-key test was tightened to require ErrInvalidKey.
